statement: A superquadratic separation of sensitivity and block sensitivity. Constructs total Boolean functions with block sensitivity $`\mathop{\mathrm{bs}}\nolimits (f)\ge s(f)^\alpha`$ for a fixed α > 2, disproving the quadratic strengthening of the Sensitivity Conjecture. Here $`s(f)`$ counts influential individual-bit flips, while block sensitivity allows disjoint groups of bits to change together.
